title: Exclude unitary paired cycles at every selected precondition cut
body:
PR2491 leaves open whether a unitary centre-sharing action could work before its nonunitary precondition. This closes that specific escape for the selected word: all 7,400 precondition gates write only to the 112 Y fields, and the full centre reader annihilates those fields. The entire physical reader is therefore unchanged at all 7,401 cuts.

The proof uses the simple implication `M(Y)=0` and `range(C-I) subset Y` ⇒ `MC=M`. It needs neither unitary preconditioning nor commutation with entry adapters. The same Gram diagonal `(150,130,146,134,122,126,142,146)` excludes all 1,260 paired-four-cycle output permutations at every audited cut, even with arbitrary unitary input mixing and unitary payload maps on output edges. All 704 inputs, including 480 dirty helpers, remain arbitrary.

This is a finite cut census plus a written operator lemma under PR2491's inherited exact native-frame binding. It is not a new native compiler audit, a universal changed-cut obstruction, a supplier, a recursive cost saving or a new kappa. Changed totals, later reader-active cuts, output normalization and paid nonunitary actions remain open; PR2500's separate child-cost correspondence obligation still applies.

Validation:

- Registered optimized Python 3.12 replay passes the primary check, separate integer-dyadic forward checker, and five behavioral test groups.
- Reverse Fraction covectors and forward integer-dyadic execution agree on all 5,632 reader coefficients at all 7,401 cuts. The independent checker imports no predecessor or primary executable.
- Actual reader-visible writes, source corruption before executable import, missing/typed-corrupted evidence and dedicated guard-removal sensitivity are detected. Reader-preserving prefix sign/order changes correctly pass. A noncommuting fixture tests signs/order, and a generic nonunitary-prefix counterexample prevents overgeneralization.
- Git-free read-only replay and exact exclusive regeneration pass. Python 3.14 optimized replays and selected-record integrity pass. No hosted CI success, human/formal-kernel review or full selected cold replay is claimed.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-reader-precondition-cuts
```

Only `research/selected-reader-precondition-cuts/` is added. Base and refreshed canonical main: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. PR2491 is pinned at `c25a4ce22a887daf8cba8b3cfad72796752ab2ee` and its head is unchanged at submission. Exact archive/member/source pins, the scope change from the task-picker suggestion, and remaining obligations are in the package.
